t: $(item)Dimensional Shard Ore$() can be found underground in small clusters in various dimensions. It is affected by $(thing)Fortune$(), and drops $(item)Dimensional Shards$() when broken. $(br2)These are used in several more complicated recipes, and can also be used to $(l:rftoolsbase:machines/infusing)infuse machines$().
$(item)维度碎片矿石$()可以在多种维度的地下以小矿脉形式找到。它受$(thing)时运$()影响，破坏后会掉落$(item)次元裂片$()。$(br2)这些材料用于多种较复杂的配方，也可用于$(l:rftoolsbase:machines/infusing)为机器注能$()。
Some Dimensional Shard Ore underground in the Overworld.
主世界地下会生成一些维度碎片矿石。
$(item)Dimensional Shards$() can also be used for the creation of a variety of $(item)Decorative Blocks$().
$(item)次元裂片$()还可用于制作多种$(item)装饰性方块$()。
If you had RFTools Dimensions, you could make some pretty cool decorative blocks, but you can't, oh well :(
如果你有 RFTools Dimensions，就能制作一些相当酷的装饰方块，但你没有，唉 :(
